title: VisionCal corruption surface & selective risk
protocol: Frozen 64→48→10 MLP; same 360 historical held-out IDs, new fixed-seed corruptions, 8 conditions. Temperature frozen on prior validation. Test sweeps descriptive, not safety threshold selection.
findings: Temperature changes probabilities, not argmax accuracy.
Increasing noise/occlusion/translation tests brittleness without claiming real OCR robustness.
Coverage/error must be read together; writer isolation remains unavailable.
scope: AI-assisted new local stress experiments; no retraining, external API, private data or production claim
